name: Windows Explorer
description: Basisset aan aanbevolen Windows 11-beveiligingsinstellingen voor Windows Explorer.

settings.id: Turn off Data Execution Prevention for Explorer
settings.name: Turn off Data Execution Prevention for Explorer
settings.description: Disabling data execution prevention can allow certain legacy plug-in applications to function without terminating Explorer.
settings.rationale: Disabling data execution prevention for Explorer may be necessary for compatibility with certain legacy plug-ins, but it reduces protection against malicious code execution.

settings.id: Turn off heap termination on corruption
settings.name: Turn off heap termination on corruption
settings.description: Disabling heap termination on corruption allows Explorer to continue running even if heap corruption is detected.
settings.rationale: Turning off heap termination on corruption may be necessary for compatibility with certain legacy plug-ins, but it reduces protection against memory corruption attacks.

settings.id: Turn off shell protocol protected mode
settings.name: Turn off shell protocol protected mode
settings.description: Disabling shell protocol protected mode allows Explorer to handle certain shell protocol operations without the additional security restrictions.
settings.rationale: Turning off shell protocol protected mode may be necessary for compatibility with certain legacy plug-ins, but it reduces protection against potentially unsafe shell protocol operations.

settings.id: Do not preserve zone information in file attachments
settings.name: Do not preserve zone information in file attachments
settings.description: Disabling the preservation of zone information in file attachments prevents Windows from marking files with their originating security zone.
settings.rationale: Not preserving zone information may be necessary for compatibility with certain legacy applications, but it reduces protection against potentially unsafe files downloaded from the internet.

settings.id: Hide mechanisms to remove zone information
settings.name: Hide mechanisms to remove zone information
settings.description: Hiding mechanisms to remove zone information prevents users from bypassing the security zone markings on files.
settings.rationale: Hiding these mechanisms may be necessary for compatibility with certain legacy applications, but it reduces the ability of users to manage potentially unsafe files downloaded from the internet.

settings.id: Notify antivirus programs when opening attachments
settings.name: Notify antivirus programs when opening attachments
settings.description: Notifying antivirus programs when opening attachments ensures that antivirus software is aware of potentially unsafe files.
settings.rationale: This setting helps maintain security by allowing antivirus programs to scan attachments, reducing the risk of malware infections.

settings.name: Enable Smart Screen In Shell
settings.description: Enabling Smart Screen in Shell helps protect against malicious websites and downloads by providing warnings and blocking potentially unsafe content.
settings.rationale: This setting enhances security by leveraging Smart Screen to detect and prevent access to harmful content.

settings.id: Prevent Override For Files In Shell
settings.name: Prevent Override For Files In Shell
settings.description: Preventing override for files in Shell ensures that users cannot bypass security warnings for potentially unsafe files.
settings.rationale: This setting enhances security by enforcing the Smart Screen warnings and preventing users from ignoring them.

changelog.notes: Release of Windows Explorer Hardening baseline version 1.0.0
